mapper.select: select id, bookID, studentID, ISBN, borrowTime, returnTime from record
select id, bookID, studentID, ISBN, borrowTime, returnTime from record where id = #{id}
select id, bookID, studentID, ISBN, borrowTime, returnTime from record where bookID = #{id}
select id, bookID, studentID, ISBN, borrowTime, returnTime from record where studentID = #{studentID}
select id, bookID, studentID, ISBN, borrowTime, returnTime from record where ISBN = #{ISBN}
select id, bookID, studentID, ISBN, borrowTime, returnTime from record where returnTime is null
mapper.insert: insert into record(bookID, studentID, ISBN, borrowTime, returnTime) VALUES (#{bookID}, #{studentID}, #{ISBN}, now(), null)
mapper.update: update record set returnTime = now() where id = #{id}
